recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It completes the FHIR-22655 application in current build-scope datatype sources while preserving the later FHIR-53492 decision not to allow .5-style decimals.
issue_request: FHIR-22655 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core datatypes and asked whether decimal values were otherwise unbounded outside XML/JSON serialization notes; the approved resolution was to change the decimal description and regex to say decimal cannot have more than 18 digits and a decimal point.
initial_application: d621ab0bda added the 18-digit statement to source/datatypes.html. baee733e3e attempted the primitive regex update but introduced an extra closing brace and still allowed too many combined integer/fraction digits. FHIR-53492 later removed the extra brace but did not address the total mantissa digit inconsistency.
additional_context: The active datatypes page links to datatypes examples, source/datatypes/primitives.xml feeds primitive datatype metadata and regex substitution, and source/xml.html contains a schema-override pattern for implementers. Later FHIR-53492 confirmed the leading zero before fractional decimals should remain required, so the reconciliation retained that rule while tightening the digit limit.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes.html to define the limit as no more than 18 mantissa digits excluding sign, decimal point, and exponent; updated source/datatypes/primitives.xml to state the limit and use a regex that enforces it; updated source/xml.html to mirror that regex; and shortened the XML/JSON pi examples in source/datatypes-examples.html to valid 18-digit high-precision examples.
source_changes: source/datatypes.html: clarified decimal's 18-digit mantissa limit and removed arbitrary-precision wording that could imply unbounded decimals.
source/datatypes/primitives.xml: updated the decimal primitive definition and regex to enforce no more than 18 mantissa digits.
source/xml.html: aligned the decimal xs:string override pattern with the primitive regex.
source/datatypes-examples.html: shortened high-precision decimal examples to remain valid under the 18-digit limit.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the extra closing brace in the decimal regex and confirmed the leading-zero requirement remains; audited separately in this run.
Earlier AutoFHIR audit aligned decimal primitive wording and BigDecimal guidance; this reconciliation preserves that clarification while adding the FHIR-22655 digit limit.
